# 24highshop

> Swiss smartshop for botanicals and mycology, based in Zürich and trading since 2018. 1’152 products across six shops — mushroom grow kits, spores and cultures, kratom and kanna, cannabis genetics, CBD, and headshop hardware — shipped from Swiss stock in plain packaging, usually within one to two working days.

## Key facts

- Legal name: 24highshop AG, Zürich, Switzerland
- Currency: CHF or EUR, switchable on any page; both include 8.1% Swiss VAT
- Minimum order: EUR 200 (about CHF 210), reachable with any mix of products
- Shipping: included on every order; 1–2 working days within Switzerland, 2–6 elsewhere in Europe, always tracked
- Packaging: plain and unmarked, no branding or product name outside
- Payment: Bitcoin (on-chain, rate locked 15 minutes) and bank transfer (SEPA or Swiss IBAN). No cards.
- Returns: 14 days on unopened items; perishables and opened consumables excluded
- Age policy: strictly 18+
- Legal note: cannabis below 1% THC is lawful in Switzerland. Psilocybin is controlled and is NOT sold. Kratom is sold as a botanical specimen, not for consumption.
